svg.title: The rules' cost per scheduler step
svg.desc: The wall time of one call of vLLM 0.32.0's Scheduler.schedule() on the host's CPU in each state, on a log scale whose second axis is the box's CPU, 1.63 times as long, beside the box's steps (a voice reply's alone, 12 ms; beside held agent prefill, 16 to 20 ms; the agents' at 24 agent sessions, 38 ms), for stock vLLM, the change with its switches off (within 3.7% of stock's in every state) and the configuration to deploy (its change to the step from −56 to +1,473 µs): only lower-priority work, 16 running: 322, 326 and 384 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running: 792, 796 and 883 µs; only lower-priority work, 256 running: 2,664, 2,679 and 2,840 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,576, 1,581 and 1,632 µs; only lower-priority work, 64 running, no prefix hit: 686, 692 and 734 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 324, 329 and 651 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running: 801, 806 and 1,169 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running: 2,607, 2,627 and 3,094 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 256 running, 10 waiting: 2,620, 2,640 and 3,107 µs; a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 64 running, a 999-block prefix hit: 1,558, 1,563 and 3,036 µs; every running slot taken, 16 running: 178, 180 and 335 µs; every running slot taken, 64 running: 657, 663 and 847 µs; every running slot taken, 256 running: 2,468, 2,475 and 2,751 µs; in the serving profile, only agents, 2 running: 68, 71 and 90 µs; in the serving profile, a reply's first tokens, an agent waiting that fits, 2 running: 114, 116 and 60 µs; in the serving profile, a waiting turn needs more room than two victims free, 16 running: 241, 239 and 328 µs; in the serving profile, the step that preempts for a waiting turn, 2 running: 192, 196 and 672 µs.
